text: The purpose of this report is to present the updated 2018 audited financial results for The Board of Directors of the Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts (operating as TO Live).

The TO Live - Audit Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the 2018 Audited Financial Results as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live, remain confidential in its entirety because if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position of interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons or organization.
